text: Terminology / translation: "u0417u0427u0420u0411" does not name an operative statute — third-country access runs through ЗТМТМ and ЗНРА, so the bucket is labelled by the act that would actually be amended; "МРЗ" is the statutory monthly minimum, not "минимално работно възнаграждане"; "максимален осигурителен доход / осигурителен праг" is the social-insurance ceiling; "ЗПС" is the Fiscal General Republic Act (Закон за публичните финанси). All Bulgarian paraphrases and titles above are my translations, and outlets mix лв and € for the same amount.
